Name: Maggs Emo Sebastian Seasonal Outfits Sprites and Portraits
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Full pack of seasonal, festival, and alternate sprites with matching portraits for Sebastian.[/b][/size]
Options include short, mid-length (like vanilla) or long hair, hair colors: black or red with an option to have the hair dynamically grow out by season with a dialogue mention, several accessories and piercing options (for portraits), unique outfits for all festivals plus options for the Flower Dance, Moonlight Jellies, and Spirit's Eve, pajamas with warm weather options, beach white tee or shirtless, smoking options for non-smoking, and more little surprises!

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218459.png[/img][/size][/color]
[/b]See the images for examples of the options.
*  Select Portrait Style, either original cuter style or new edgier and slightly older-looking style
*  Short, mid-length or long hair, with color options: black, red
*  Dynamic hair option: dyed hair grows out (black in spring and fall, grown out with roots in summer and winter) Skin tone varies for natural black hair and natural red hair
*  Taller overworld sprite option
*  Hoodie color options: dark color tones or gray and black
*  Beach options: white tee or shirtless
*  Smoking option adds a video game or lollipop animation if non-smoking (does not remove smoking dialogue, use [b]Magg's Non-Smoking Sebastian[/b] for this)
*  Festival outfits with options for Flower Dance, Moonlight Jellies, and Spirit's Eve
Accessories
[list]
[*]Piercings - mix and match: choose as many as you like! [/*]
[*]Eyeliner[/*]
[*]Glasses[/*]
[*]Mermaid's Pendant - [b]NEW[/b][/*]
[*]Beard - full beard, or 5 o'clock shadow[/*]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f]Frog Buddy: A little frog follows Sebby around![/color][/b][/*]
[/list][b]Other features:[/b]
Dynamic hood up in rain/snow
Frog pajamas (shown after marriage, working on fixing time issue)
Wedding suit

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]
This sprite mod is fully stand-alone, but is also compatible with all of Magg's mods:
[list]
[*][b]Non-Smoking Sebastian:[/b] Select "Non-smoking" in the configuration menu.[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Sebastian: [/b]Select the same smoking option in the configuration menu as you have for Immersive Seb, either Smoking or Quit Smoking. [/*]
[/list]
Special thanks to Owanora for the long hair Sebastian sprite inspiration, the sprite on this mod is a slightly altered variation.
